The '''Skraj'Tais''' or "Skyland" was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] orbiting the planet [[Coyn]] that functioned as a large [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. The station was capable of hosting hundreds of ships at a time and was similar in design to [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]]. It was the major starport for those who had no business on Coyn itself and was the most likely refueling and servicing destination for those just passing through the system.<ref name="PotG3" />
